title: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
title_zh: VMSA：面向长视频理解的视频记忆技能智能体
abstract_en: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.
abstract_zh: 长视频问答需要从数小时甚至数天的视频中检索并整合相关证据。现有智能体虽能借助外部记忆迭代检索，却仍难以判断该搜什么、该查哪类记忆，以及如何串联相隔很远的证据。Video Memory Skill Agent（VMSA）联合设计了结构化视频记忆与记忆技能。Segment Caption Memory（片段描述记忆）和 Entity Event Memory（实体事件记忆）提供可检索的证据，Entity-Aware Episode Memory（实体感知情节记忆）则提供兼顾全局与细节的上下文，引导检索与推理。VMSA 还从成功的智能体轨迹中归纳记忆技能，逐步完善或扩充精简的技能库，以指导迭代检索、推理和验证。在七项长视频问答基准中，VMSA 在三项周级第一人称视角基准上均取得最高准确率，在 Ego-R1 Bench 上较最强基线最高提升 9.4%，在其余四项基准上达到最佳或有竞争力的表现。消融实验验证了三类记忆与记忆技能的贡献，并表明记忆技能还能改善证据的时间定位。
key_points_zh: 两类记忆分别索引片段描述和实体事件，第三类记忆提供跨片段的情节上下文，帮助串联时间上相隔较远的证据。
从成功轨迹中归纳可复用技能，并逐步更新技能库，指导智能体迭代检索、推理和验证。
三项周级第一人称视角基准均获最高准确率；在 Ego-R1 Bench 上较最强基线最高提升 9.4%。
消融实验显示，三类记忆与记忆技能均有贡献，且记忆技能可改善证据的时间定位。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是为长视频问答智能体联合设计三层离线视频记忆、检索与核验工具，以及从成功轨迹中增量归纳的技能库。逐项消融支持三层记忆的互补作用；四个基准上的有无技能对照显示，技能同时改善答题准确率和时间证据定位。固定其余组件的对照还量化了技能库规模与准确率的权衡。
